_note: Two real plays (sequenceNumber 27 and 30) verbatim from ESPN's plays[] for this real, completed game. Verified by importing and running the real _normalize_event_type/_extract_player_name/_build_team_map functions from that module against this fetched response. `id` is ESPN's own play id (as a number); `created_at` is ESPN's `wallclock` timestamp for the play. Our own live API does not retain historical play-by-play (see GameDetailPage.test.jsx comments) — this is why ESPN is the source here instead of frontend/src/services/api.js's /games/{id}/plays.
